scope: Read-only source review of an ordinary old-prompt build, before its research session completed; not an accepted dataset performance report.

evidence.verification_scope: Downloaded manifest, bounded source archive, qualification report and quality declaration only. Verified sizes/digests and build/run member hashes. No dataset CSV fetched, no local full-artifact acceptance or source execution.

findings.evidence: run.sh invokes build.py before qualify_dataset.py. build.py lines 705-751 writes/logs split rates, computes eval/holdout reference AUCs and logs them. The entrypoint contains no --accept before this scoring.
findings.implication: A later passing report does not establish compliance with qualification/acceptance-before-scoring. Move scoring to a post-qualification exact-artifact acceptance stage; do not weaken the gate.

findings.evidence: Within the loop over eval and holdout, build.py assigns majority_class_accuracy = round(train_rate, 4), without evaluating constant predictions against that split.
findings.implication: The field is training prevalence, not measured split accuracy. Do not quote it as held-out accuracy.

findings.evidence: The country/approval_fy rate table is fitted on train years; eval/holdout use disjoint future approval years. Every unseen country/year key falls back to country_fallback.
findings.implication: This comparison provides no calendar contribution and cannot support a calendar-only control claim. Use a defined, train-fitted temporal reference if scientifically justified.

findings.kind: unsupported scientific claim; needs source evidence
findings.evidence: History uses latest-vintage IEG evaluation_fy/outcome records; documentation calls omission of later-re-evaluated projects a conservative lower bound on prior_msplus_share.
findings.implication: Removing observations can raise or lower a share. Evaluation fiscal year alone also does not prove public availability at a historical instant. Current sector/taxonomy/amount fields require their own as-of support; declarations and the passing mechanical report do not settle it.

findings.kind: interpretation concern, not a claim that the proposed follow-up ran
findings.evidence: STATE.md at d77213d proposes packaging if a further holdout comparison favors the full model after the eval comparison did not. It also states artifact fetch-back and --accept occurred on the coordinator.
findings.implication: Keep the adverse eval comparison and distinguish a post-result holdout investigation from predeclared validation. Favorable holdout performance would not repair feature-vintage evidence or baseline implementation defects. Full-artifact transfer and acceptance should remain on workers under the coordinator policy.

intervention.instruction: Preserve the active ordinary run/artifacts and ownership, keep the candidate private, and carry findings into the next review. No restart or interruption requested.
intervention.evaluation_limit: Any later response to these supplied findings is assisted review/repair, not an unprompted new-prompt improvement. No measured dataset performance is reported here.
